body.p: Claim 47 is amended to replace "a locator object" with "the positioning element". The terms are used interchangeably in the specification for example in paragraph [0091]. The change is believed to add to clarification of the subject matter of the claims. No new matter is being added, and this does not change the scope of the claims. Therefore, this amendment under 37 CFR 1.312 for after allowance amendment is believed to be proper. Should the examiner have any questions concerning this amendment it would be appreciated if the undersigned were contacted at the number provided.
